item.title: Regulator opens inquiry into platform practices
item.description: Officials said the review will examine how the company ranks search results against its own competing products.

item.title: Chipmaker unveils next generation processor
item.description: The new chip promises a large jump in performance per watt compared with the previous generation, the company said.

item.title: Browser update patches critical vulnerability
item.description: Security researchers found the flaw could let an attacker run code remotely, and the fix is rolling out automatically.
